object: Frozen C041 MAGIC/gamma/fixed-width 3CNF decoder activation thresholds used by C042
accepted_proof_obligations: gamma length is 2 floor(log2 t)+1 for positive t and the payload has 3m(1+bit_length(v)) bits
L0>=16 with equality only at v=m=1, and the sole nonempty clause is satisfiable
canonical UNSAT implies m>=2, so L0>=24 with equality only at v=1,m=2
at v=1 a mixed-sign clause is tautological and constant-sign clauses are x and not-x, yielding exactly two opposing ordered payloads
the raw equality lengths 16 and 24 are even, so padding does not change them
the half-word split is a bijection between 2n-bit words and [2^n]^2
required_scope_clarifications: length 24 is first canonical MAGIC long-form UNSAT, not first UNSAT decoder word
the threshold is decoder-specific and assumes repeated literals are allowed
the special all-zero short-code contradiction is separate; malformed nonzero words decode to tautology
parent-to-child indices are n=4 to U5, n=8 to U9, and n=12 to U13
